units: 1 Blender unit = 1 stud; X along the roll, Y outward (loose end toward -Y), Z up; origin = centre of the footprint on the ground
roblox_mapping: Size = (bx, bz, by); CFrame = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) * CFrame.new(-cx, cz, cy); anchor/direction 'roblox' = (x, z, -y) relative to the pivot (the mesh origin); an anchor's 'roll' is degrees about the item axis (Blender +Z = Roblox +Y): anchor frame = CFrame.new(roblox) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(roll), 0); Tool.Grip = grip frame (in Handle space)

base.note: rests here: the middle of its footprint on the surface
